englishDefinition: A design pattern that converts one interface into another that the rest of the code expects.
exampleSentence: We wrote an adapter pattern so the legacy API fits the interface our new code expects.
exampleTranslation: 我们写了一个适配器模式，让这个老旧的接口能符合新代码所期望的接口形式。

englishDefinition: A design pattern that lets an algorithm be selected and swapped at runtime through a shared interface.
exampleSentence: The strategy pattern lets us switch pricing rules without touching the checkout logic.
exampleTranslation: 策略模式让我们可以切换定价规则，而不用改动结算逻辑。

englishDefinition: A design pattern that adds new behavior to an object dynamically by wrapping it.
exampleSentence: We used the decorator pattern to add caching around the existing data fetcher.
exampleTranslation: 我们用装饰器模式给已有的数据获取逻辑包裹上了一层缓存。

englishDefinition: A design pattern that provides a simplified interface to a more complex subsystem.
exampleSentence: The facade pattern hides three different SDKs behind one simple analytics interface.
exampleTranslation: 外观模式把三个不同的 SDK 隐藏在了一个简单的统计接口后面。

englishDefinition: A design pattern that constructs a complex object step by step through a fluent interface.
exampleSentence: We used a builder pattern to construct the request instead of a constructor with ten parameters.
exampleTranslation: 我们用建造者模式来构造这个请求对象，而不是用一个带十个参数的构造函数。

englishDefinition: A common but ineffective or counterproductive approach to solving a recurring problem.
exampleSentence: Catching every exception and doing nothing with it is a classic anti-pattern.
exampleTranslation: 捕获所有异常却不做任何处理，是一个典型的反模式。

englishDefinition: A written document that describes the design, constraints, and implementation approach for a feature or system.
exampleSentence: Write a technical specification before starting on such a large piece of work.
exampleTranslation: 在开始做这么大的工作之前，先写一份技术方案文档。

englishDefinition: A small, quick implementation built to test whether an idea is technically feasible.
exampleSentence: We built a proof of concept over two days to see if the approach was even viable.
exampleTranslation: 我们花了两天时间做了一个概念验证，来看看这个方案是否可行。

englishDefinition: The process of defining the architecture, components, and interfaces of a large software system.
exampleSentence: The system design needs to account for ten times today's traffic.
exampleTranslation: 这次系统设计需要考虑到当前流量十倍的规模。

englishDefinition: A pattern where state changes are stored as a sequence of events instead of just the current state.
exampleSentence: With event sourcing, we can always replay the events to see how an order reached its current state.
exampleTranslation: 有了事件溯源，我们随时可以重放事件，看看一个订单是如何变成当前状态的。

englishDefinition: The ability of a system to handle multiple tasks making progress during overlapping time periods.
exampleSentence: Handling concurrency correctly is what made this feature so much harder than it looked.
exampleTranslation: 正确处理并发问题，正是这个功能比看上去难得多的原因。

englishDefinition: Executing multiple tasks at literally the same time, typically on multiple processor cores.
exampleSentence: We used parallelism to process each image on a separate core simultaneously.
exampleTranslation: 我们用并行的方式，让每张图片同时在不同的核心上处理。

englishDefinition: The smallest unit of execution that can be scheduled by an operating system.
exampleSentence: Never update the UI from a background thread directly.
exampleTranslation: 永远不要直接从后台线程更新界面。

englishDefinition: Running multiple threads within a single program to perform tasks concurrently.
exampleSentence: Multithreading introduced subtle bugs that only showed up under heavy load.
exampleTranslation: 多线程引入了一些只有在高负载下才会出现的隐蔽 bug。

englishDefinition: A group of pre-created, reusable threads that execute tasks from a shared queue.
exampleSentence: We resized the thread pool after profiling showed too many threads were sitting idle.
exampleTranslation: 在性能分析发现大量线程处于空闲状态后，我们调整了线程池的大小。

englishDefinition: A lock that ensures only one thread can access a shared resource at a time.
exampleSentence: We wrapped the shared counter update in a mutex to prevent a race condition.
exampleTranslation: 我们用互斥锁把这个共享计数器的更新操作包裹起来，以防止竞态条件。

englishDefinition: A synchronization tool that limits how many threads can access a resource at the same time.
exampleSentence: A semaphore limits the number of concurrent downloads to four.
exampleTranslation: 一个信号量把并发下载的数量限制在了四个。

englishDefinition: An operation that completes fully or not at all, with no other thread able to observe it half-done.
exampleSentence: Incrementing the counter needs to be an atomic operation, or two threads can lose an update.
exampleTranslation: 递增这个计数器必须是原子操作，否则两个线程可能会互相覆盖对方的更新。

englishDefinition: The process of allocating and releasing memory a program uses while it runs.
exampleSentence: Manual memory management gives more control but also more room for bugs.
exampleTranslation: 手动内存管理带来了更多控制权，但也带来了更多出错的空间。

englishDefinition: A bug where a program fails to release a resource, such as a file handle or connection, after it's no longer needed.
exampleSentence: An unclosed file handle was causing a slow resource leak.
exampleTranslation: 一个没有关闭的文件句柄正在导致缓慢的资源泄漏。

englishDefinition: The amount of work a system can process in a given period of time.
exampleSentence: The new batching approach doubled the pipeline's throughput.
exampleTranslation: 新的批处理方式让这个流水线的吞吐量翻了一倍。

englishDefinition: The single component that limits the overall performance of a system.
exampleSentence: Profiling showed the database query was the real bottleneck, not the rendering code.
exampleTranslation: 性能分析显示真正的瓶颈是这条数据库查询，而不是渲染代码。

englishDefinition: Measuring where a program spends its time and resources to find optimization opportunities.
exampleSentence: Profiling revealed that most of the time was spent parsing the same file repeatedly.
exampleTranslation: 性能分析显示大部分时间都花在了反复解析同一个文件上。

englishDefinition: Delaying the computation of a value until it is actually needed.
exampleSentence: Lazy evaluation means this expensive calculation only runs if the result is actually used.
exampleTranslation: 惰性求值意味着这个昂贵的计算只有在结果真正被用到时才会执行。

englishDefinition: Computing a value as soon as it's defined, rather than waiting until it's needed.
exampleSentence: We switched to eager evaluation here so errors surface immediately instead of later.
exampleTranslation: 我们在这里改用了及早求值，让错误能立刻暴露出来，而不是延后才出现。

englishDefinition: The rules that determine what to cache, how long to keep it, and when to refresh it.
exampleSentence: We changed the caching strategy from time-based expiry to event-based invalidation.
exampleTranslation: 我们把缓存策略从基于时间过期改成了基于事件失效。

englishDefinition: Caching the results of expensive function calls so repeated calls with the same input return instantly.
exampleSentence: Memoization avoided recalculating the same expensive result on every re-render.
exampleTranslation: 记忆化避免了每次重新渲染都要重新计算同一个昂贵的结果。

englishDefinition: The process of storing and restoring the state of a thread so a CPU can switch between tasks.
exampleSentence: Too many threads caused excessive context switching, hurting overall performance.
exampleTranslation: 线程数量过多导致了过度的上下文切换，反而影响了整体性能。

englishDefinition: Describing a task whose speed is limited primarily by processor computation rather than I/O.
exampleSentence: This task is CPU-bound, so adding more network capacity won't speed it up.
exampleTranslation: 这个任务是 CPU 密集型的，增加网络带宽并不会让它变快。

englishDefinition: Describing a task whose speed is limited primarily by input/output operations, such as disk or network access.
exampleSentence: Since the job is I/O-bound, running it on more CPU cores barely helps.
exampleTranslation: 因为这个任务是 I/O 密集型的，增加 CPU 核心数几乎没什么帮助。

englishDefinition: An I/O model where operations return immediately instead of waiting, letting the program handle other work.
exampleSentence: Non-blocking I/O lets a single server handle thousands of open connections at once.
exampleTranslation: 非阻塞 I/O 让单台服务器能够同时处理成千上万个打开的连接。

englishDefinition: A runtime mechanism that continuously checks for and dispatches pending events or callbacks.
exampleSentence: Blocking the event loop with a synchronous call froze the entire server.
exampleTranslation: 用一次同步调用阻塞了事件循环，导致整个服务器都卡住了。

englishDefinition: A property of code that behaves correctly when accessed by multiple threads at the same time.
exampleSentence: We added thread safety to this cache after seeing corrupted entries under load.
exampleTranslation: 在观察到高负载下缓存条目出现损坏后，我们为这个缓存加上了线程安全保证。

englishDefinition: A situation where multiple processes or threads compete for the same limited resource.
exampleSentence: Resource contention on the database connection pool was slowing every request down.
exampleTranslation: 数据库连接池的资源争用拖慢了每一个请求。

englishDefinition: The process of adjusting a system to improve its speed, throughput, or resource usage.
exampleSentence: After a round of performance tuning, page load time dropped by half.
exampleTranslation: 经过一轮性能调优，页面加载时间减少了一半。

englishDefinition: The extra delay when a system or function starts running from an idle or freshly initialized state.
exampleSentence: The serverless function's cold start added almost a second to the first request.
exampleTranslation: 这个无服务器函数的冷启动给第一次请求增加了近一秒的延迟。

englishDefinition: A lock where a thread repeatedly checks in a loop until the lock becomes available, rather than sleeping.
exampleSentence: A spin lock made sense here since the critical section only takes a few instructions.
exampleTranslation: 因为这段临界区代码只需要几条指令，所以用自旋锁在这里是合理的。

englishDefinition: A background thread dedicated to running tasks off the main thread.
exampleSentence: We offloaded image processing to a worker thread to keep the UI responsive.
exampleTranslation: 我们把图片处理任务转移到了一个工作线程上，以保持界面响应流畅。

englishDefinition: A piece of data issued after login that proves a user's identity on subsequent requests.
exampleSentence: The mobile app stores the authentication token securely in the device keychain.
exampleTranslation: 这个移动端应用把身份验证令牌安全地存储在设备的钥匙串里。

englishDefinition: The set of rules that determine who can access which resources in a system.
exampleSentence: A gap in access control let regular users reach an admin-only endpoint.
exampleTranslation: 访问控制上的一个漏洞让普通用户也能访问到仅限管理员的接口。

englishDefinition: An access control model that grants permissions based on a user's assigned role rather than individually.
exampleSentence: We introduced role-based access control so permissions are managed by role, not by individual user.
exampleTranslation: 我们引入了基于角色的访问控制，让权限按角色而不是按单个用户来管理。

englishDefinition: The process of converting data into a coded form to prevent unauthorized access.
exampleSentence: All data is encrypted in transit using encryption between the app and the server.
exampleTranslation: 应用和服务器之间的所有数据在传输过程中都会加密。

englishDefinition: The process of converting encrypted data back into its original, readable form.
exampleSentence: Decryption of the file failed because the key had already been rotated.
exampleTranslation: 这个文件的解密失败了，因为密钥已经被轮换过了。

englishDefinition: Converting data into a fixed-size value using a one-way function, commonly used to store passwords securely.
exampleSentence: Passwords are never stored as plain text — only their hashing result is saved.
exampleTranslation: 密码从不以明文存储——数据库里只保存它们哈希处理后的结果。

englishDefinition: An attack that inserts malicious SQL code through user input to manipulate a database.
exampleSentence: Using parameterized queries prevents SQL injection even with untrusted user input.
exampleTranslation: 使用参数化查询可以防止 SQL 注入，即便面对不可信的用户输入也是如此。

englishDefinition: An attack that injects malicious scripts into pages viewed by other users.
exampleSentence: We escape all user-generated content to prevent cross-site scripting.
exampleTranslation: 我们对所有用户生成的内容都进行转义，以防止跨站脚本攻击。

englishDefinition: An attack that tricks a logged-in user's browser into submitting an unwanted request to another site.
exampleSentence: The form now includes a token to protect against cross-site request forgery.
exampleTranslation: 这个表单现在带上了一个令牌，用来防范跨站请求伪造。

englishDefinition: A weakness in a system that could be exploited to cause harm or unauthorized access.
exampleSentence: The security scan found a vulnerability in an outdated third-party library.
exampleTranslation: 安全扫描在一个过时的第三方库里发现了一个安全漏洞。

englishDefinition: Authorized simulated attacks on a system used to find and fix security weaknesses.
exampleSentence: We hired an outside firm to run penetration testing before the public launch.
exampleTranslation: 我们在正式公开发布之前，请了一家外部机构进行渗透测试。

englishDefinition: A login method that requires two separate forms of verification, such as a password and a code.
exampleSentence: We strongly recommend enabling two-factor authentication on your account.
exampleTranslation: 我们强烈建议你为账号开启双因素认证。

englishDefinition: An attack where someone steals a valid session token to impersonate a logged-in user.
exampleSentence: Rotating session tokens regularly makes session hijacking much harder to pull off.
exampleTranslation: 定期轮换会话令牌让会话劫持变得难得多。

englishDefinition: An incident where sensitive data is accessed or exposed without authorization.
exampleSentence: The company had to notify all affected users after the data breach.
exampleTranslation: 这次数据泄露发生后，公司不得不通知所有受影响的用户。

englishDefinition: Building security into a system's architecture from the start, rather than adding it later.
exampleSentence: We treated this API as secure by design, requiring authorization checks at every layer.
exampleTranslation: 我们按照安全设计原则来构建这个 API，要求在每一层都进行权限检查。

englishDefinition: The principle of giving a user or system only the minimum access needed to do its job.
exampleSentence: Following least privilege, the service account can only read from this one table.
exampleTranslation: 按照最小权限原则，这个服务账号只能读取这一张表。

englishDefinition: Data that requires special protection, such as personal, financial, or health information.
exampleSentence: Sensitive data like CVs and interview notes should never be logged in plain text.
exampleTranslation: 像简历和面试笔记这样的敏感数据绝不能以明文形式被记录到日志里。

englishDefinition: Hiding or obscuring parts of sensitive data so it can be used safely without exposing the real values.
exampleSentence: Data masking replaces most digits of the card number with asterisks before display.
exampleTranslation: 数据脱敏会在显示之前把卡号的大部分数字替换成星号。

englishDefinition: A record of who did what and when, used to track and review sensitive actions.
exampleSentence: We checked the audit log to see who had changed the user's permissions.
exampleTranslation: 我们查了审计日志，看看是谁修改了这个用户的权限。

englishDefinition: An update released to fix a known security vulnerability.
exampleSentence: We applied the security patch the same day it was released.
exampleTranslation: 这个安全补丁发布的当天我们就应用上了。

englishDefinition: A network security system that controls incoming and outgoing traffic based on defined rules.
exampleSentence: The firewall blocks all inbound traffic except on the ports we explicitly allow.
exampleTranslation: 这个防火墙会拦截除我们明确允许的端口之外的所有入站流量。

englishDefinition: Protocols that encrypt data sent between a client and a server over a network.
exampleSentence: The certificate expired, so connections over SSL/TLS started failing.
exampleTranslation: 证书过期了，导致通过 SSL/TLS 建立的连接开始失败。
pronunciationText: S S L T L S

englishDefinition: The point after which a security token is no longer considered valid and must be renewed.
exampleSentence: We shortened token expiration to limit the damage if a token is ever leaked.
exampleTranslation: 我们缩短了令牌过期时间，以限制万一令牌泄露所造成的损害。

englishDefinition: Checking that incoming data meets expected rules before it is processed further.
exampleSentence: Missing input validation let an empty string through and crashed the report generator.
exampleTranslation: 缺少输入校验让一个空字符串混了进去，导致报表生成器崩溃。

englishDefinition: To remove or escape potentially dangerous characters from user input before using it.
exampleSentence: Always sanitize input before rendering it back onto the page.
exampleTranslation: 在把用户输入渲染回页面之前，一定要先清理输入。

englishDefinition: A security flaw that is exploited before the vendor has released a fix for it.
exampleSentence: The team worked through the weekend to patch the zero-day vulnerability.
exampleTranslation: 团队整个周末都在加班修复这个零日漏洞。

englishDefinition: Removing or transforming personally identifiable information so individuals can no longer be identified.
exampleSentence: We apply data anonymization before sharing usage statistics with the analytics team.
exampleTranslation: 在把使用数据分享给数据分析团队之前，我们会先做数据匿名化处理。

englishDefinition: A structured analysis of potential attackers, attack paths, and risks to a system.
exampleSentence: Our threat model assumes an attacker could gain access to the internal network.
exampleTranslation: 我们的威胁模型假设攻击者有可能获得内部网络的访问权限。

englishDefinition: A practice of frequently merging code changes into a shared branch and automatically building and testing them.
exampleSentence: Continuous integration catches most build failures within minutes of a push.
exampleTranslation: 持续集成能在代码推送后几分钟内就发现大部分构建失败的问题。

englishDefinition: Automatically releasing every change that passes the pipeline straight to production.
exampleSentence: With continuous deployment, a merged pull request can be live in production within minutes.
exampleTranslation: 有了持续部署，一个合并的拉取请求几分钟内就能在生产环境上线。

englishDefinition: An automated sequence of steps that compiles, tests, and packages code.
exampleSentence: The build pipeline failed at the linting stage before it even reached the tests.
exampleTranslation: 构建流水线在还没跑到测试阶段之前，就在代码检查环节失败了。

englishDefinition: A lightweight, isolated package that bundles an application with everything it needs to run.
exampleSentence: Each service runs in its own container so dependencies never conflict.
exampleTranslation: 每个服务都运行在自己的容器里，依赖之间不会产生冲突。

englishDefinition: A read-only template that contains everything needed to run a container.
exampleSentence: We rebuild the Docker image automatically whenever the base dependencies change.
exampleTranslation: 每当基础依赖发生变化时，我们都会自动重新构建 Docker 镜像。

englishDefinition: An open-source platform that automates the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications.
exampleSentence: Kubernetes automatically restarts the pod when the health check fails.
exampleTranslation: 当健康检查失败时，Kubernetes 会自动重启这个 pod。

englishDefinition: Managing and provisioning infrastructure through machine-readable configuration files instead of manual setup.
exampleSentence: Infrastructure as code lets us recreate the entire environment from a single config file.
exampleTranslation: 基础设施即代码让我们可以只用一个配置文件就重建整个环境。

englishDefinition: A company that offers computing infrastructure and services over the internet.
exampleSentence: We chose this cloud provider mainly because of its regional data centers.
exampleTranslation: 我们选择这家云服务提供商主要是因为它在该地区有数据中心。

englishDefinition: A software-based emulation of a physical computer that runs its own operating system.
exampleSentence: We spun up a virtual machine to test the deployment script in isolation.
exampleTranslation: 我们启动了一台虚拟机，用来单独测试这个部署脚本。

englishDefinition: Automatically adjusting the number of running instances based on current demand.
exampleSentence: Auto-scaling added three more instances during the traffic spike and removed them afterward.
exampleTranslation: 自动扩缩容在流量高峰期增加了三个实例，高峰过后又把它们撤下了。

englishDefinition: An automated sequence of stages that moves a build from testing through to production.
exampleSentence: The deployment pipeline requires a manual approval step before hitting production.
exampleTranslation: 这条部署流水线在到达生产环境之前需要人工审批这一步。

englishDefinition: A release strategy that keeps two identical environments and switches traffic between them to enable instant rollback.
exampleSentence: Blue-green deployment let us switch back to the previous version instantly when the new one misbehaved.
exampleTranslation: 蓝绿部署让我们在新版本出问题时能立刻切回上一个版本。

englishDefinition: Rolling out a change to a small subset of users first to catch problems before a full release.
exampleSentence: The canary release was rolled back after error rates spiked for that small group of users.
exampleTranslation: 在那一小部分用户的错误率飙升后，这次金丝雀发布被回滚了。

englishDefinition: Reverting a deployed release back to a previous, known-good version.
exampleSentence: We triggered a deployment rollback the moment error rates crossed the threshold.
exampleTranslation: 一旦错误率超过阈值，我们就立刻触发了部署回滚。

englishDefinition: A named value set outside the application code, used to configure its behavior per environment.
exampleSentence: The database URL is read from an environment variable, never hardcoded.
exampleTranslation: 数据库地址是从环境变量里读取的，从不硬编码。

englishDefinition: The practice of systematically tracking and controlling changes to a system's configuration.
exampleSentence: Configuration management keeps every server's settings consistent across the fleet.
exampleTranslation: 配置管理让整个服务器集群的设置保持一致。

englishDefinition: A storage system used to keep and version build outputs, such as packages or images.
exampleSentence: Every build is uploaded to the artifact repository before it can be deployed.
exampleTranslation: 每次构建产物都要先上传到制品仓库，然后才能被部署。

englishDefinition: Automating the steps needed to compile, test, and package software.
exampleSentence: Build automation removed the last manual step from our release process.
exampleTranslation: 构建自动化去掉了我们发布流程中最后一个手动步骤。

englishDefinition: A cloud execution model where the provider manages the servers and automatically scales code on demand.
exampleSentence: We moved the image resizing job to serverless computing so we stop paying for idle servers.
exampleTranslation: 我们把图片压缩任务迁移到了无服务器计算上，这样就不用再为闲置服务器付费了。

englishDefinition: The process of setting up the infrastructure and resources a system needs before it can run.
exampleSentence: Provisioning a new environment used to take a day; now it takes minutes.
exampleTranslation: 以前配置一个新环境需要一天时间，现在只需要几分钟。

englishDefinition: Deploying a build to a staging environment for final verification before production.
exampleSentence: Every pull request triggers a staging deployment so reviewers can click through the change.
exampleTranslation: 每个拉取请求都会触发一次预发布部署，方便审查者亲自点击体验这次改动。

englishDefinition: How often a team ships changes to production, often used as a measure of delivery speed.
exampleSentence: Our deployment frequency went from once a week to several times a day.
exampleTranslation: 我们的部署频率从每周一次提升到了每天好几次。

englishDefinition: An approach where servers are never modified after deployment — instead, a new one replaces the old.
exampleSentence: With immutable infrastructure, we replace the whole instance rather than patching it in place.
exampleTranslation: 在不可变基础设施下，我们是替换整个实例，而不是在原地打补丁。

englishDefinition: A storage service used to store, version, and distribute container images.
exampleSentence: The deployment pulls the latest image straight from the container registry.
exampleTranslation: 这次部署会直接从容器镜像仓库拉取最新的镜像。

englishDefinition: Software that automates the deployment, scaling, and coordination of multiple services or containers.
exampleSentence: The orchestration tool restarts any container that stops responding to health checks.
exampleTranslation: 这个编排工具会自动重启任何未能响应健康检查的容器。

englishDefinition: The output produced by a build process, such as a compiled binary or package.
exampleSentence: The same build artifact is promoted from staging to production without being rebuilt.
exampleTranslation: 同一个构建产物会从预发布环境直接晋升到生产环境，而不需要重新构建。

englishDefinition: A server that sits in front of backend servers and forwards client requests to them.
exampleSentence: The reverse proxy terminates TLS before forwarding the request to the application.
exampleTranslation: 反向代理会先终止 TLS 连接，再把请求转发给应用程序。

englishDefinition: A tool that automates installing, updating, and removing software libraries and their dependencies.
exampleSentence: The package manager flagged two dependencies with known vulnerabilities.
exampleTranslation: 这个包管理器标记出了两个存在已知漏洞的依赖。

englishDefinition: A document summarizing what changed in a new software release.
exampleSentence: Check the release notes before upgrading — this version removes an old API.
exampleTranslation: 升级之前先看一下发布说明——这个版本移除了一个旧接口。

englishDefinition: A configuration switch that turns a feature on or off without deploying new code.
exampleSentence: We shipped the new checkout behind a feature flag so it can be turned off instantly if needed.
exampleTranslation: 我们把新的结算功能放在了一个功能开关后面，需要时可以立刻关闭。

englishDefinition: A visual display of a system's key metrics used to track its health in real time.
exampleSentence: The monitoring dashboard showed error rates climbing minutes before users started reporting issues.
exampleTranslation: 在用户开始反馈问题的几分钟前，监控仪表盘上的错误率就已经开始攀升。

englishDefinition: Automatically notifying the responsible team when a metric crosses a defined threshold.
exampleSentence: We set up alerting so the on-call engineer gets paged if latency exceeds two seconds.
exampleTranslation: 我们配置了告警机制，一旦延迟超过两秒，值班工程师就会收到寻呼通知。

englishDefinition: The amount of time a system remains available and operational.
exampleSentence: The service maintained 99.9 percent uptime last quarter.
exampleTranslation: 这个服务上个季度维持了 99.9% 的正常运行时间。

englishDefinition: A period during which a system is unavailable or not functioning.
exampleSentence: We scheduled the maintenance for the middle of the night to minimize downtime.
exampleTranslation: 我们把维护安排在了半夜进行，以尽量减少宕机时间。

englishDefinition: A formal commitment defining the expected level of service, such as uptime or response time.
exampleSentence: Our service level agreement promises a response to critical incidents within thirty minutes.
exampleTranslation: 我们的服务级别协议承诺在三十分钟内响应重大事故。

englishDefinition: The organized process a team follows to detect, contain, and resolve a live production issue.
exampleSentence: Our incident response plan starts with paging the on-call engineer.
exampleTranslation: 我们的事故响应流程第一步就是寻呼值班工程师。

englishDefinition: A structured review after an incident that documents what happened and how to prevent it from recurring.
exampleSentence: We wrote a blameless postmortem after the outage to capture the timeline and next steps.
exampleTranslation: 这次故障之后，我们写了一份不追责的事后复盘，记录了时间线和后续行动。

englishDefinition: A schedule that assigns team members to be responsible for responding to incidents during set periods.
exampleSentence: I'm on the on-call rotation this week, so my phone stays on all night.
exampleTranslation: 这周我在值班轮换名单上，所以手机整晚都得开着。

englishDefinition: The average amount of time it takes to restore service after a failure.
exampleSentence: Better runbooks cut our mean time to recovery in half.
exampleTranslation: 更完善的处置手册把我们的平均恢复时间缩短了一半。

englishDefinition: The ability to understand a system's internal state from the logs, metrics, and traces it produces.
exampleSentence: Better observability meant we could pinpoint the failing service within seconds.
exampleTranslation: 更好的可观测性让我们能在几秒钟内定位出故障服务。

englishDefinition: Numeric measurements collected over time to track a system's behavior or performance.
exampleSentence: We track latency and error rate as our two most important metrics.
exampleTranslation: 我们把延迟和错误率作为最重要的两个指标来追踪。

englishDefinition: A method of tracking a single request as it flows through multiple services, to diagnose latency and errors.
exampleSentence: Distributed tracing showed the request spent most of its time waiting on a single downstream service.
exampleTranslation: 分布式追踪显示这次请求的大部分时间都花在了等待某一个下游服务上。

englishDefinition: An automated check that verifies whether a service is running correctly.
exampleSentence: The load balancer stops routing traffic to any instance that fails its health check.
exampleTranslation: 负载均衡器会停止向任何未通过健康检查的实例分发流量。

chineseMeaning: 升级路径（问题上报流程）
englishDefinition: The predefined sequence of people or teams to contact if an issue isn't resolved quickly enough.
exampleSentence: If the on-call engineer doesn't respond in ten minutes, the escalation path pages their manager.
exampleTranslation: 如果值班工程师十分钟内没有响应，升级路径就会寻呼他们的主管。

englishDefinition: A step-by-step guide for handling a specific operational task or known type of incident.
exampleSentence: The runbook walks the on-call engineer through restarting the failed service safely.
exampleTranslation: 这份操作手册一步步指导值班工程师安全地重启失败的服务。

englishDefinition: A discipline focused on keeping systems available, performant, and resilient to failure.
exampleSentence: Reliability engineering is why the system keeps running even when one region goes down.
exampleTranslation: 正是可靠性工程的实践，让这个系统在某个地区宕机时依然能保持运行。

englishDefinition: The maximum amount of acceptable failure a service can have while still meeting its reliability target.
exampleSentence: We paused new feature launches after burning through this quarter's error budget.
exampleTranslation: 在用完这个季度的错误预算后，我们暂停了新功能的上线。

englishDefinition: A structured process for identifying the true underlying cause of a problem.
exampleSentence: The root cause analysis traced the outage back to a single misconfigured retry policy.
exampleTranslation: 这次根因分析最终把故障追溯到了一个配置错误的重试策略上。

englishDefinition: The gradual or full release of a new version or feature to users.
exampleSentence: We paused the rollout at ten percent of users after seeing an unexpected spike in crashes.
exampleTranslation: 在发现崩溃率意外飙升后，我们在覆盖 10% 用户时暂停了这次推出。

englishDefinition: An out-of-cycle release that ships a critical fix outside the normal release schedule.
exampleSentence: We shipped a hotfix release within an hour of confirming the payment bug.
exampleTranslation: 在确认这个支付相关的 bug 之后一小时内，我们就发布了一个紧急修复版本。

englishDefinition: A public page that reports the current operational status and any ongoing incidents of a service.
exampleSentence: We posted an update on the status page as soon as the incident was confirmed.
exampleTranslation: 确认这次事故之后，我们立刻在状态页上发布了更新。

englishDefinition: A state where engineers become desensitized to alerts because there are too many low-value ones.
exampleSentence: We tuned the thresholds to reduce alert fatigue on the on-call team.
exampleTranslation: 我们调整了告警阈值，以减轻值班团队的告警疲劳。

englishDefinition: A state where a service is still running but performing noticeably worse than normal.
exampleSentence: Users reported service degradation before the dashboard showed any red alerts.
exampleTranslation: 在仪表盘出现红色告警之前，用户就已经反馈了服务降级的情况。

englishDefinition: The plans and procedures used to restore systems and data after a major failure or catastrophe.
exampleSentence: We test our disaster recovery plan by simulating a full region outage every quarter.
exampleTranslation: 我们每个季度都会模拟一次整个地区宕机，来测试灾难恢复计划。

englishDefinition: Deliberately injecting failures into a system to test its resilience before real incidents happen.
exampleSentence: Chaos engineering revealed a hidden dependency that would have caused a full outage.
exampleTranslation: 混沌工程实验揭示了一个隐藏的依赖关系，若不修复本会导致一次全面宕机。

englishDefinition: The policy defining how long logs are kept before being deleted or archived.
exampleSentence: We extended log retention to ninety days to support longer investigations.
exampleTranslation: 我们把日志保留期延长到了九十天，以支持更长时间跨度的排查。

englishDefinition: The regular rhythm or schedule at which a team ships new releases.
exampleSentence: We settled on a two-week release cadence to balance stability and speed.
exampleTranslation: 我们最终确定了两周一次的发布节奏，以兼顾稳定性和速度。

englishDefinition: The process of collecting and understanding what stakeholders need from a feature or system.
exampleSentence: We spent the first week on requirements gathering before writing a single line of code.
exampleTranslation: 在写下第一行代码之前，我们花了第一周的时间做需求收集。

englishDefinition: A written document that lays out the proposed approach, trade-offs, and details for a piece of work before it's built.
exampleSentence: Share the design doc with the team before you start implementation.
exampleTranslation: 在开始实现之前，先把设计文档分享给团队。

englishDefinition: A meeting at the start of a sprint where the team decides what work to commit to.
exampleSentence: We reprioritized the backlog right before sprint planning.
exampleTranslation: 我们在迭代计划会议之前重新排列了待办事项的优先级。

englishDefinition: A short daily meeting where team members share progress, plans, and blockers.
exampleSentence: I mentioned the blocked deployment during this morning's standup meeting.
exampleTranslation: 我在今天早上的站会上提到了部署被阻塞的情况。

englishDefinition: A recurring meeting where a team reflects on what went well and what to improve.
exampleSentence: We brought up the deployment issues in the sprint retrospective.
exampleTranslation: 我们在这次迭代的回顾会议上提出了部署方面的问题。

englishDefinition: Transferring responsibility for a task, project, or on-call duty from one person or team to another.
exampleSentence: We documented everything before the handoff to the support team.
exampleTranslation: 在交接给支持团队之前，我们把所有信息都记录了下来。

englishDefinition: A team that includes members from different disciplines, such as engineering, design, and product.
exampleSentence: This feature was built by a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and a product manager.
exampleTranslation: 这个功能是由一个包含工程师、设计师和产品经理的跨职能团队一起完成的。

englishDefinition: To raise a problem to someone with more authority or context when it can't be resolved at the current level.
exampleSentence: If the vendor doesn't respond by tomorrow, we'll need to escalate an issue to their account manager.
exampleTranslation: 如果供应商明天还没回应，我们就需要把这个问题上报给他们的客户经理。

englishDefinition: To ask questions and confirm details so a requirement is fully and correctly understood.
exampleSentence: I scheduled a quick call to clarify requirements before estimating the work.
exampleTranslation: 在给这项工作做估算之前，我安排了一次简短的通话来澄清需求。

englishDefinition: A conversation focused on identifying unusual scenarios a design or requirement might not have considered.
exampleSentence: The edge case discussion surfaced a scenario the original spec never mentioned.
exampleTranslation: 这次边界情况讨论发现了一个原始需求文档从未提到过的场景。

englishDefinition: Reaching shared agreement among stakeholders on exactly what is and isn't included in a piece of work.
exampleSentence: We held a short meeting for scope alignment before committing to a deadline.
exampleTranslation: 在承诺截止日期之前，我们开了一个简短的会议来做范围对齐。

englishDefinition: Actively passing expertise or context from one team member to others.
exampleSentence: We hold a weekly knowledge sharing session so no single person is the only one who understands a system.
exampleTranslation: 我们每周都会举办一次知识共享分享会，避免某个系统只有一个人懂。

englishDefinition: Written material that explains how a system works or how to use it.
exampleSentence: The documentation was out of date, which cost the new engineer half a day.
exampleTranslation: 文档已经过时了，这让新来的工程师白白花了半天时间。

englishDefinition: The process of helping a new team member get set up and productive.
exampleSentence: Our onboarding checklist gets a new engineer to their first deployed change within a week.
exampleTranslation: 我们的入职引导清单能让一名新工程师在一周内就完成第一次上线改动。

englishDefinition: A session where a developer explains a piece of code to others, often to share context or gather feedback.
exampleSentence: I gave a code walkthrough of the new billing module to the rest of the team.
exampleTranslation: 我给团队其他成员做了一次新计费模块的代码讲解。

englishDefinition: A meeting where a proposed technical design is presented and critiqued before implementation begins.
exampleSentence: The design review raised concerns about how the system would scale.
exampleTranslation: 这次设计评审提出了对系统可扩展性的担忧。

englishDefinition: A balance struck between two competing options, where gaining one thing means giving up another.
exampleSentence: There's a trade-off between shipping fast and keeping the code maintainable.
exampleTranslation: 在快速上线和保持代码可维护性之间，存在一个权衡取舍。

englishDefinition: Agreement and support from key stakeholders before proceeding with a plan.
exampleSentence: We got stakeholder buy-in on the new timeline before communicating it to the wider team.
exampleTranslation: 我们先获得了相关方对新时间表的支持，然后才把它传达给更大范围的团队。

englishDefinition: A specific, assigned task that comes out of a meeting or discussion.
exampleSentence: Each action item from the postmortem was assigned an owner and a due date.
exampleTranslation: 复盘会议中的每一个行动项都指定了负责人和截止日期。

englishDefinition: A subsequent message or meeting checking on the progress or outcome of something already discussed.
exampleSentence: I sent a follow-up to confirm whether the fix had actually resolved the issue.
exampleTranslation: 我发了一条跟进消息，确认这个修复是否真正解决了问题。

englishDefinition: Something that is preventing a person or team from making progress on their work.
exampleSentence: Waiting on design assets is my biggest blocker this week.
exampleTranslation: 等待设计素材是我这周最大的阻碍因素。

englishDefinition: Resistance or objection raised in response to a proposal or decision.
exampleSentence: We got pushback from the security team on storing the data unencrypted.
exampleTranslation: 对于未加密存储这些数据的方案，我们收到了安全团队的反对意见。

englishDefinition: The process of working with multiple people to reach an agreement everyone can support.
exampleSentence: Consensus building took longer than the implementation itself.
exampleTranslation: 达成共识花的时间比实际实现这个功能还要长。

englishDefinition: Communication that doesn't require both parties to be available at the same time, such as written messages.
exampleSentence: We rely on async communication across time zones instead of scheduling every discussion live.
exampleTranslation: 面对跨时区协作，我们更依赖异步沟通，而不是每次讨论都安排实时会议。

englishDefinition: A brief report on the current progress of a task or project.
exampleSentence: Send a status update to the stakeholders every Friday afternoon.
exampleTranslation: 每周五下午都要给相关方发送一次进展汇报。

englishDefinition: A situation where a requirement can be reasonably interpreted in more than one way.
exampleSentence: The requirement ambiguity around 'active user' led two teams to build different definitions.
exampleTranslation: 围绕“活跃用户”这个概念的需求歧义，导致两个团队分别实现了不同的定义。

englishDefinition: Writing clear, structured documents that explain technical concepts, systems, or processes.
exampleSentence: Strong technical writing skills made her design docs easy for anyone to follow.
exampleTranslation: 扎实的技术写作能力让她写的设计文档任何人都能轻松看懂。

englishDefinition: A cycle in which the results of an action are used to inform and improve future actions.
exampleSentence: A tight feedback loop with users helped us catch usability problems early.
exampleTranslation: 与用户之间紧密的反馈循环帮助我们尽早发现了可用性问题。

englishDefinition: The combination of programming languages, frameworks, and tools used to build a product.
exampleSentence: Could you walk me through the tech stack you used for this project?
exampleTranslation: 能不能介绍一下你在这个项目中使用的技术栈？

englishDefinition: To fully accept responsibility for a task or outcome, including seeing it through to completion.
exampleSentence: I took ownership of the migration from start to finish, including the rollback plan.
exampleTranslation: 我主动承担了这次迁移从头到尾的责任，包括制定回滚方案。

englishDefinition: A thorough, detailed examination of a specific topic or piece of work.
exampleSentence: The interviewer asked for a deep dive into how I debugged the production incident.
exampleTranslation: 面试官让我深入探讨一下当时是如何排查那次生产事故的。

englishDefinition: Questions a candidate prepares to ask the interviewer, usually near the end of the interview.
exampleSentence: Always prepare a few thoughtful questions for the interviewer about the team and the role.
exampleTranslation: 一定要提前准备几个有深度的问题，用来反问面试官关于团队和这个岗位的情况。

englishDefinition: A request to explain a piece of code line by line, including the reasoning behind it.
exampleSentence: Can you walk through your code and explain why you chose this approach?
exampleTranslation: 你能讲解一下你的代码，说说为什么选择这种实现方式吗？

englishDefinition: An interview format where a candidate solves a coding or design problem on a whiteboard, often live.
exampleSentence: The whiteboard interview focused on a graph problem and how I'd explain my reasoning out loud.
exampleTranslation: 这次白板面试聚焦在一道图论题目，以及我如何把思路大声讲出来。

englishDefinition: A coding or design task a candidate completes independently, outside the interview, within a given deadline.
exampleSentence: The take-home assignment asked us to build a small API within a week.
exampleTranslation: 这次带回家完成的测试题要求我们在一周内实现一个小型 API。

englishDefinition: An interview question that asks about a real past experience to predict how a candidate handles similar situations.
exampleSentence: The behavioral question asked me to describe a time I disagreed with a teammate.
exampleTranslation: 这个行为面试问题让我描述一次和同事意见不合的经历。

englishDefinition: An early-stage interview, often shorter, used to verify a candidate's baseline technical ability.
exampleSentence: The technical screen was a thirty-minute call covering basic data structure questions.
exampleTranslation: 这次技术初筛面试是一通三十分钟的电话，主要考察基础的数据结构问题。

englishDefinition: An interview round focused on designing a large-scale system, evaluating architecture and trade-off decisions.
exampleSentence: In the system design interview, I was asked to design a URL shortening service.
exampleTranslation: 在这次系统设计面试中，我被要求设计一个短链接服务。

englishDefinition: A programming problem given to a candidate to assess their coding ability, often under time pressure.
exampleSentence: The online coding challenge had a strict ninety-minute time limit.
exampleTranslation: 这次在线编程测试题有严格的九十分钟时间限制。

englishDefinition: An interview format where the candidate writes code together with an interviewer in real time.
exampleSentence: The pair programming interview let me show how I actually communicate while coding.
exampleTranslation: 这次结对编程面试让我能够展示自己在编码时的实际沟通方式。

englishDefinition: A common interview topic asking a candidate to reflect honestly on their strong and weak points.
exampleSentence: When asked about my strengths and weaknesses, I gave a concrete example for each.
exampleTranslation: 被问到优点和缺点时，我为每一点都举了一个具体的例子。

englishDefinition: A common interview prompt asking a candidate to describe their proudest professional accomplishment.
exampleSentence: My greatest achievement was leading the migration that cut our infrastructure costs by a third.
exampleTranslation: 我最大的成就是主导了一次把基础设施成本降低了三分之一的迁移工作。

englishDefinition: A common interview prompt asking a candidate to explain a difficult situation and how they handled it.
exampleSentence: Describe a challenge you faced when a project's requirements changed midway through.
exampleTranslation: 描述一次项目需求在中途发生变化时你面对的挑战。

englishDefinition: To manage a disagreement between people constructively, a common behavioral interview topic.
exampleSentence: How do you handle conflict when a teammate disagrees with your technical decision?
exampleTranslation: 当同事不认同你的技术决定时，你是如何处理冲突的？

englishDefinition: The advancement of a person's skills, responsibilities, and role over time.
exampleSentence: I'm looking for a role that offers real career growth, not just a title change.
exampleTranslation: 我在找一个能带来真正职业发展的岗位，而不只是换个头衔。

englishDefinition: Working effectively with people from teams outside your own to achieve a shared goal.
exampleSentence: This project required close cross-team collaboration with the mobile and design teams.
exampleTranslation: 这个项目需要和移动端团队、设计团队进行密切的跨团队协作。

englishDefinition: A workplace where priorities, projects, or demands change quickly and often.
exampleSentence: I thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift within a day.
exampleTranslation: 我在优先级一天之内就可能变化的快节奏工作环境中表现得很出色。

englishDefinition: A person who takes initiative and starts working on tasks without needing to be told.
exampleSentence: The job posting says they're looking for a self-starter who can work with minimal supervision.
exampleTranslation: 这份招聘启事说他们在找一个能在很少监督下工作、自我驱动的人。

englishDefinition: The rate at which a person gains new skills or knowledge, often used to describe how hard something is to pick up.
exampleSentence: There's a steep learning curve with this framework, but it pays off after the first few weeks.
exampleTranslation: 这个框架的学习曲线很陡，但坚持过最初几周之后就会觉得值得。

englishDefinition: The structured set of steps a new hire goes through to get set up and productive at a new job.
exampleSentence: I asked about the onboarding process to understand how quickly new engineers start shipping.
exampleTranslation: 我询问了入职流程，想了解新工程师大概多久能开始正式上线代码。

englishDefinition: The salary and benefits range a candidate is looking for, often discussed in later interview rounds.
exampleSentence: The recruiter asked about my compensation expectations before scheduling the next round.
exampleTranslation: 招聘人员在安排下一轮面试之前询问了我的薪资期望。

englishDefinition: The amount of time an employee must work after resigning before officially leaving the company.
exampleSentence: My notice period is one month, so I could start the new role in early next month.
exampleTranslation: 我的离职通知期是一个月，所以下个月初就可以开始新的岗位。

englishDefinition: The belief that abilities can be developed through effort and learning, rather than being fixed.
exampleSentence: I try to approach every failed deployment with a growth mindset instead of getting discouraged.
exampleTranslation: 面对每一次失败的部署，我都尽量用成长型思维去看待，而不是感到气馁。

englishDefinition: The ability to analyze a difficult situation and find an effective solution.
exampleSentence: This interview question was really testing my problem-solving skills under time pressure.
exampleTranslation: 这道面试题实际上是在测试我在时间压力下的问题解决能力。

englishDefinition: To work closely with people in different roles or departments toward a shared goal.
exampleSentence: This role requires you to collaborate cross-functionally with design, product, and QA.
exampleTranslation: 这个岗位需要你和设计、产品、QA 等不同职能的同事进行跨职能协作。
